propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through a single Pydantic Agent operation with a shared request budget, eliminating the split between bespoke retry orchestration and Pydantic AI
Retry context must preserve complete failed responses when proven to fit, otherwise omit them entirely, preventing truncation of authoritative input, output, or stored history

Rebar must retain deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal/filter behavior, typed exhaustion, final-failure artifacts, and answering-model provenance after Pydantic Agent integration
Usage reporting must emit complete Pydantic run usage exactly once per successful operation, while fallback/downgrade candidates remain trace or journal events rather than competing usage counters
The bespoke structured-output retry loop removal is gated on compatibility suite and authorized provider cache-canary passes, with live evidence from cutover verification
